summary: Scoped starting-point critique on champion adapter
hypothesis: Adding a scoped critique pass (judging only starting-point coverage) on top of the champion adapter's draft should patch the single biggest coverage gap without disturbing its other strengths, because the adapter already produces high-quality drafts and a targeted 2nd pass should reliably identify the one missing decision-critical unknown.
technique: The champion adapter (v2a_e1) generates a draft verbatim, then a second adapter call acts as a scoped critic judging only starting-point coverage and swapping at most one weak or redundant slot for a task-specific starting-point question — a minimal-surface single-slot repair ported from exp023 onto the adapter.
result: Scored 0.398 on the full-30 greedy eval (2 wins / 4 ties / 23 losses vs Sonnet), down −0.011 from the champion's 0.409 — discarded. Coverage stayed pinned at 3 and the same starting-point misses recurred, confirming the adapter's scoped critique returns drafts as "covered" too readily and cannot reliably self-identify its own biggest coverage gap via a targeted 2nd pass.
